commit 1d914f7e8e1cedf772a919118eb218f35e632c17
Author: Dev <dev@example.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 23 23:40:35 2026 -0300

    ci: add fmt, clippy, cross-platform tests and release workflow
    
    Release builds musl Linux, macOS and MSVC Windows binaries for x86_64
    and aarch64, writes a .sha256 per asset plus SHA256SUMS, and checks that
    the tag matches every version string. Also run .cmd shims on Windows
    through cmd /C only when such a shim exists on PATH.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit ba24a5a18a68e2ae9f53f6cfb7e272711b3a5d40
Author: Dev <dev@example.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 23 23:39:49 2026 -0300

    feat: mirror user Bash permission rules before rewriting
    
    Claude Code evaluates permission rules against the rewritten command, so
    an allow rule like Bash(cargo test:*) stopped matching and deny rules
    could be bypassed. The PreToolUse hook now checks the original command
    against the user's settings: deny/ask rules skip the rewrite, a matching
    allow rule is restated as permissionDecision allow, and unmatched
    commands are rewritten only in auto/bypassPermissions mode unless
    rewrite.unapproved = "rewrite".
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 43db9c7464220915b7797ba126425e016fd70763
Author: Dev <dev@example.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 23 23:39:49 2026 -0300

    feat: add plugin manifest, marketplace, hooks and launcher
    
    hooks/hooks.json wires SessionStart, PreToolUse(Bash) and
    PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit) to bin/hk, a POSIX sh launcher that
    execs a cached binary or downloads the release asset for the platform
    and verifies its SHA256. Hooks fail open when no binary is available.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 90e282da18a55839216d5fedb63eee4fcdce0049
Author: Dev <dev@example.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 23 23:33:39 2026 -0300

    feat: add hk crate with output filters, hooks, format and stats
    
    Single binary with run, hook, stats, filters and map subcommands.
    Filters for cargo test, pytest, vitest/jest, go test, deno/bun test,
    build/typecheck diagnostics and installers, with a generic head/tail
    fallback. Snapshot tests over real captured fixtures.
